item.title: Government introduces Model Context Protocol server to integrate AI tools with official statistical databases | IBEF
item.description: The Government has introduced a Model Context Protocol server to integrate AI tools with official statistical databases, enhancing data accessibility, interoperability, and evidence-based policymaking.

item.title: Bharat Innovates showcases India’s rise as a global innovation hub | IBEF
item.description: Union Minister for Education Mr. Dharmendra Pradhan highlighted India’s emergence as a global innovation hub at the Bharat Innovates platform, driven by strong policy support, startups, and research ecosystem growth.

item.title: Prime Minister Mr. Narendra Modi Says, India’s West Asia Approach Highlights Its Strength and Decisive Action | IBEF
item.description: Prime Minister Mr. Narendra Modi highlighted India’s strong crisis management, strategic diplomacy, and economic resilience amid the ongoing West Asia conflict, reinforcing the country’s global credibility.

item.title: PAIMANA platform tracks 1,702 projects across ministries to strengthen infrastructure monitoring | IBEF
item.description: The PAIMANA platform is tracking 1,702 infrastructure projects across 17 ministries, enhancing real-time monitoring, coordination, and efficiency in project execution.

item.title: Maruti Suzuki to invest US$ 1.09 billion for new Gujarat plant, 2.5 lakh unit capacity | IBEF
item.description: Maruti Suzuki’s Rs. 10,189 crore (US$ 1.09 billion) investment in a new Gujarat plant will add 2.5 lakh units of annual capacity, strengthening India’s automotive manufacturing ecosystem.

item.title: India’s media & entertainment sector projected to reach US$ 37.9 billion by 2028 | IBEF
item.description: India’s media and entertainment sector is projected to reach Rs. 3.3 lakh crore (US$ 37.9 billion) by 2028, driven by digital media growth, rising advertising revenues, and strong expansion in live events.

item.title: PM Surya Ghar Yojana Delivers Scale with 26 Lakh Installations and US$ 1.94 billion Support | IBEF
item.description: PM Surya Ghar Yojana has achieved over 26 lakh rooftop solar installations, with Rs. 17,967 crore (US$ 1.94 billion) disbursed to support clean energy adoption and household electrification.

item.title: Railways Minister Mr. Ashwini Vaishnaw Launches Five Reforms in Railways’ 52 Reforms in 52 Weeks Drive | IBEF
item.description: Indian Railways introduces five new reforms under its ‘52 Reforms in 52 Weeks’ initiative to enhance passenger convenience, streamline logistics, and improve operational efficiency.

item.title: India’s Total Exports Rise to US$ 714.73 Billion in FY26 (Apr-Jan) | IBEF
item.description: India’s exports rose to Rs. 67.01 lakh crore (US$ 714.73 billion) in FY26 (April-January), reflecting resilient growth and strengthening its global trade position despite external challenges.

item.title: Government Expands DEH Initiative to Boost District-Level Export Competitiveness | IBEF
item.description: Government expands the Districts as Export Hubs (DEH) initiative, enabling district-led export growth, empowering MSMEs, and enhancing India’s global trade competitiveness.
